title: Hydraulic Oil Temperature Sensor Ground Fault
detail_of_failure: The pump controller senses a ground fault in the hydraulic oil temperature sensor circuit.
controller_action: When the cause of failure no longer exists, the machine returns to normal.
machine_effect: • The hydraulic oil temperature gauge shows approximately 50°C. • The fan speed reaches maximum speed.
related_information: Monitoring code The signal voltage of the hydraulic oil temperature sensor can be monitored. (Code: 04402)

steps.procedure: 1. Check the wiring harnesses and connectors. REMARK For details of the inspection method, see “RELA- TED INFORMATION TO TROUBLESHOOT”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”. 2. Are the wiring harnesses and connectors normal?

branches.YES: • The wiring harnesses and connectors are normal. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • A wiring harness or connector is defective. • Repair or replace the defective wiring harness or connector. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.
